content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Digital product

The solution to this problem is not a workaround, but rather a base-layer infrastructure that gives creators full control over their digital commerce stack. This stack consists of free and paid tools that work together to provide automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. By using this infrastructure, creators can sell their digital products without depending on platforms that charge high fees, such as Gumroad, which charges 10% on every sale, compared to NOWPayments' 0.5% fee.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of this digital commerce stack is built using free tools like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. For automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, NOWPayments is used, which has a 0.5% fee and supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. This architecture allows for instant product delivery via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, giving creators a seamless and efficient way to sell their digital products.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This digital commerce stack is built for digital creators who sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software, but cannot use conventional payment platforms due to restrictions in their country or region. By using this infrastructure, creators can take control of their sales and customer data, and avoid platform fees that eat into their revenue. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference between Gumroad and NOWPayments retains $921, making this infrastructure a crucial investment for creators who want to maximize their earnings.
Sovereign digital commerce stacks give creators full control over their sales and customer data.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components of this digital commerce stack work together seamlessly to provide a robust and efficient sales process. For example, when a customer makes a payment, NOWPayments automatically verifies the transaction and triggers the delivery of the digital product via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. This process is instant and automated, giving creators more time to focus on producing high-quality digital products and growing their customer base.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this digital commerce stack today, creators can start by choosing the right components for their needs, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. They can then integrate NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment verification and set up Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for instant product delivery. With the right guidance and support, creators can have their digital commerce stack up and running in no time, and start selling their digital products with confidence and control.

Finally, test and deploy your stack, and start selling your digital products with confidence and control.
